description: The native per-step KPI widget: Min/Max/Avg time, SentBack/Rejected counts, duration filter — flow-bound, not view- or report-bound.
notes: flow_type/flow_id are written REDUNDANTLY in two places at once on a live capture: directly on Component.Data (flow_type/flow_id keys) AND as FieldMapping/Property pairs — both were observed together and both are reproduced here; write both rather than assuming either alone is sufficient.

"stepmetrics" is the only metrics_type observed; it renders the full per-step analytics table (Min/Max/Avg time + SentBack/Rejected + a duration filter) — this is the native KPI-number widget the page palette was otherwise missing before it was found.
Binds directly to a flow (Process or a list-type flow), never to a specific view or report — structurally simpler than either the view/* or report/* binding trios.

Real ids typically use the manifest_id prefix only on a fresh single-widget add (e.g. `Button_<10-char-rand>`, `Metrics_<10-char-rand>`) — the scenario this template mints for — while built-up production pages (`all_pages_draft_20260806.json`) mostly carry the generic `Component_<rand>` id instead, and Repeater/Tab/MasterDetail/Breadcrumbs were never observed prefixed at all.
